name: Krea 2 (Raw)
notes: The undistilled base: real CFG (about 3.5) and about 52 steps (er_sde / simple). Each step costs about 2x Turbo (it runs a negative pass too), so a full image takes about 13x as long as Turbo's 8 steps.
Best up to about 1 MP. Same sizes, text encoder and VAE as Turbo; the base to train and fine-tune on.
fp8_scaled and int8_convrot: speed and quality come from Turbo's files (same network, same Comfy-Org recipe), not measured on the Raw files.

variants.unconfirmed: made for the calcuis gguf node

source: Hugging Face tree API sizes (Comfy-Org/Krea-2), measured 2026-09-30

quality.method: single step from the same bf16 latent (steps 2, 4, 6 of 8), 3 prompts, LPIPS vs bf16; 0 = identical
